franchises.note: Fate series (Saber, Rin, etc.) — character-specific costumes
Vocaloid characters (Miku, etc.) — not generic clothing
VTuber-specific tags — not a character description
VRChat avatar references — not a generic trait

username_pattern.description: All lowercase alphanumeric with underscores — likely usernames
username_pattern.note: Matches entries like 'yuki_mizuki_79' with no capitals or spaces

brand_pattern.note: These are brand/studio tags, not descriptive clothing

game_title_pattern.note: Media title references, not descriptive tags

short_name.description: Remove items with name length ≤ 3 characters
short_name.note: Too short to be meaningful descriptive tags

long_compound.note: Likely concatenated or multi-tag entries that slipped through

long_no_spaces.description: Remove items with no spaces and length > 15 characters
long_no_spaces.note: Likely usernames, compound errors, or machine-generated text

double_parenthesized.note: Format: 'character_name (variant) (source)' — specific to a character, not generic
double_parenthesized.pattern_hint: name (\w+) (\w+) — two or more trailing parenthesized groups

ascension_variant.description: Items matching 'ascension' in the tag name
ascension_variant.note: Game-specific ascension/evolution variants (common in gacha games)

variant_patterns.costume_variant_description: Parenthesized costume qualifiers — these denote character-specific alt costumes, not generic clothing items

metadata.purpose: Blocklist for filtering franchise-specific, character-variant, and noise items from expanded anime prompt tag catalogs
metadata.inputs: Expanded tag catalogs (clothing, hair, eyes, general) from tag expansion pipeline
metadata.outputs: Cleaned catalog with only generic, reusable descriptive tags suitable for random character generation
metadata.rationale: Franchise-specific items (e.g., 'Saber's armor (Fate)') produce recognizable characters rather than original designs. Character costume variants (e.g., '(swimsuit)') are meaningless without the character name. Noise patterns remove non-descriptive artifacts like usernames, IDs, and garbage tags.
maintenance_notes: Add new franchises as they appear in catalogs with count >= 2
Costume variant patterns should be reviewed periodically — common anime tropes (e.g., 'school uniform') are valid generic items and should NOT be added here
Franchise terms match by substring containment — ensure short terms (e.g., 'fate') don't accidentally match unrelated words
The 'short_name' rule (≤3 chars) may need tuning per catalog — check for false positives
